samples.text:
The two maps shows an island before and after some tourist facilities were built on it. Overall, the island changed a lot, before it had only trees and a beach but now there are many buildings for tourists.

Before the development, the island was surrounded by the sea and had a beach on the south coast. The rest of island was covered with trees and there was no building.

After the development, a reception was built in the centre of the island and a restaurant was built to the east of it. There are also some huts for tourists, three huts are in the west and two huts are in the east. A footpath connect the huts with the reception and the restaurant, and another footpath go from the reception to the beach. Many trees were cut, but some trees are still in the north of island. In addition, a pier was built from the beach into the sea in the south, and there is a swimming area in the sea to the west of the pier. The beach did not change and it is still in the south.
samples.why: Overview present though a little mechanical · main additions covered · simple and repetitive linking · adequate vocabulary · several agreement, article and punctuation errors which do not affect understanding.

samples.text:
The maps illustrate the transformation of a small island following the construction of tourist facilities. Overall, what was once an undeveloped island covered largely by trees has been turned into a holiday resort with accommodation and leisure facilities, although the beach along the southern coast has been retained.

Before the development, the island had no buildings at all. Apart from the beach on its southern shore, almost the entire island was wooded.

Following the development, a large number of trees were cut down, leaving only a smaller wooded area in the north. A reception building has been constructed in the centre of the island, with a restaurant immediately to its east. Accommodation is provided by a number of huts: three are located in the western part of the island and two in the east. These are linked by a footpath, which also passes the reception and the restaurant, and a separate path runs south from the reception towards the beach.

On the coast, a pier has been built out into the sea from the beach, and a swimming area has been marked out in the water to the west of it. Apart from these, the sea around the island look the same as before.
samples.why: Clear overview contrasting before and after · additions presented logically from centre to coast · good cohesion · some less common vocabulary (retained, marked out) · mostly accurate with only minor slips.

samples.text:
The maps depict an island before and after it was developed for tourism. In essence, a largely untouched, tree-covered island has been converted into a small resort, with accommodation, dining and water-based facilities added, while its southern beach has been preserved.

Originally, the island was entirely undeveloped: a beach stretched along its southern coast, and the remainder of the land was covered in trees.

After the development, much of this woodland was cleared, and trees now survive only in the northern part of the island. At the heart of the island stands a reception building, flanked to the east by a restaurant. Tourist accommodation takes the form of five huts, three of which are situated towards the west and two towards the east. A curving footpath connects the two groups of huts, passing in front of the reception and the restaurant, while a straight path leads directly south from the reception to the beach.

The shoreline has also been altered. A pier now projects into the sea from the eastern part of the beach, and a designated swimming area has been created in the water off the western end of the beach. The sea surrounding the island is otherwise unchanged.
samples.why: Precise, well-placed overview · every addition accurately located and linked · excellent paragraph logic · sophisticated, natural vocabulary (flanked, projects, designated) · wide range of structures, error-free.
